horrid = dreadful (both mean terrible/awful). beautiful/pleasant/ordinary don't match.
furiously = fiercely (intense anger). calmly/softly/politely are opposites.
staring = gazing (looking fixedly). ignoring/waving/whispering are unrelated.
crooked ↔ straight. Text confirms: 'It's as straight as mine' vs 'becoming crooked'.
crossly (irritably) ↔ cheerfully. harshly/sternly/bitterly are similar to crossly.

his ___ fear → adjective needed. terrify(verb) → terrible(adj).
he ___ her → no longer afraid. believed connects belief to fear resolution.
